{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

duplicates = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicates.sum()}")

# Check how many times each patient_id appears
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max()}")"}
